text: 新增每日新闻专区，从 Discussion 同步日报和历史事件，并在通知中提示近三天未读日报。
en: Added daily news synchronized from Discussion, historical events and notifications for unread briefings from the last three days.

details.title: 功能内容
details.text: 顶部导航新增“每日新闻”，展示新闻标题、简介、阅读价值、媒体来源、摘要依据及原文链接，附历史上的今天，支持按日期阅读往期日报。近三天未读日报加入头像通知，与规划通知共用入口。
details.en: Daily news in the navigation shows headlines, summaries, reading value, media sources, content basis and original links, plus historical events and dated archives. Unread briefings from the last three days appear alongside planning notifications.

details.title: 使用方式
details.text: 进入每日新闻查看最新一期，从历史日报选择日期。打开通知不会清除新闻未读，成功进入对应日报才标记该期已读；同日修订不重复提醒。新闻目标10条、历史默认最多展示3条，不足按实际数量显示。
details.en: Open Daily news for the latest edition or choose a date from past briefings. Opening notifications does not clear unread news; visiting a briefing marks only that edition read. Revisions do not notify again. News targets ten stories and history displays up to three available events.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: Actions 分页读取 Discussion #9 中指定作者的 v1.1 Markdown，校验并生成站内快照，完整成功后更新与删除，失败保留旧快照；监听评论变更并定时同步。Astro 生成每日静态详情，浏览器按北京时间筛选今天及前两天，localStorage 保存本浏览器已读。上游08:40推送后仍需等待同步和部署，依赖GitHub权限与缓存；尚无快照时显示空状态，不含浏览器Token。
details.en: Actions paginates v1.1 Markdown comments by the allowed author in Discussion #9, validates a local snapshot and applies updates and deletions only on complete success. Failed syncs preserve the prior snapshot. Comment events and scheduled runs trigger sync. Astro generates dated pages; the browser uses Beijing calendar days and localStorage for per-browser read state. The 08:40 upstream push requires later synchronization and deployment, with GitHub permissions and cache availability. No snapshot shows an empty state; tokens are never sent to the browser.

text: 通知移至导航栏头像菜单，进入通知后才清除未读红点。
en: Moved notifications to the navigation avatar menu; unread dots clear only when notifications are opened.

details.title: 原来的情况
details.text: 通知位于首页内容区，展开即标为已读，没有导航栏头像入口。
details.en: Notifications appeared in the homepage content and were marked read on expansion, without a navigation avatar.

details.title: 优化方式
details.text: 导航栏新增固定星球头像，头像菜单提供通知入口；未读时头像和通知入口均显示红点，点击头像不清除，进入通知弹窗才标记已读。
details.en: A fixed planet avatar in the navigation opens a menu with Notifications. Both show unread dots; opening the avatar does not clear them. Opening the notification dialog marks items read.

details.title: 更新后的效果
details.text: 全站页面均可查看通知，无通知时保留头像入口并显示空状态；支持手机端、键盘和 Escape 关闭。
details.en: Notifications are accessible across the site. The avatar stays available with an empty state when there are no notifications; mobile, keyboard and Escape closing are supported.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: Header 复用规划快照和北京时间过期判断，原生 details 展开菜单、dialog 展示通知。固定头像采用内联 SVG；localStorage 保存本浏览器已读状态。规划状态仍需等待同步部署，清除站点数据会重置已读。
details.en: The header reuses the plan snapshot and Beijing deadline rules, with native details and dialog elements. The fixed avatar uses inline SVG; localStorage saves read state in this browser. Plan updates require synchronization and deployment; clearing site data resets read state.

text: 首页新增过期规划通知与未读红点，打开通知后隐藏红点。
en: Added overdue plan notifications on the homepage with an unread dot that clears when opened.

details.title: 功能内容
details.text: 首页提示已过计划日期且待开始或进行中的规划，显示截止日期、逾期天数和状态；没有过期项时隐藏通知。
details.en: The homepage lists overdue pending or ongoing plans with deadlines, days overdue and status. Notifications hide when none are overdue.

details.title: 使用方式
details.text: 点击“需要关注”展开通知并标记已读，红点消失；点击计划进入规划专区。新过期项再次触发红点。
details.en: Open Needs attention to read notifications and clear the dot. Follow a plan to the planning page. Newly overdue items trigger the dot again.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: 浏览器读取构建时的规划快照，按北京时间判断过期；localStorage 按评论地址及截止日期保存已读状态，仅限当前浏览器，清除站点数据后重置。状态变更需等待同步部署；存储不可用时仅记住本次访问的已读状态。
details.en: The browser checks the build-time plan snapshot against Beijing dates. localStorage tracks read items by comment URL and deadline in the current browser; clearing site data resets it. Status changes require synchronization and deployment. Without storage, read state lasts only for this visit.

text: 新增提交和推送前的代码审查门禁，检查隐私、功能更新、内容列表和回归问题。
en: Added review gates before commits and pushes for privacy, changelog quality, content listings and regressions.

details.title: 功能内容
details.text: 提交和推送前必须提供匹配代码快照的审查报告；存在红线、说明缺项或必要验证未通过时阻止操作。最终校验文档开头汇总审查点与重点关注事项，下方提供具体证据。
details.en: Commits and pushes require a report matching the code snapshot. Red lines, incomplete changelog details or failed required checks block the operation. A final document summarizes review points and concerns before detailed evidence.

details.title: 使用方式
details.text: 安装依赖后自动启用 Git hooks；暂存代码，创建并填写 review 报告，运行 review:verify，通过后暂存 JSON 与 Markdown 报告再提交。完整命令与红线见仓库 Review 规范。
details.en: Installing dependencies enables Git hooks. Stage code, create and complete a review report, run review:verify, then stage both JSON and Markdown reports and commit after checks pass. The repository review guide documents commands and red lines.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: Node 脚本将 Git 树指纹与父提交绑定至报告，提交和推送 hooks 检查对应快照；验证阶段执行现有测试、类型检查和构建，并检查正式文章与贴图的列表入口。本地 hooks 可被绕过，不能代替远程分支保护；隐私和内容语义仍需人工审查。
details.en: A Node script binds reports to Git tree fingerprints and parent commits. Commit and push hooks check those snapshots. Verification runs existing tests, type checks, builds and published content listing checks. Local hooks can be bypassed and do not replace remote branch protection; privacy and semantic correctness still require human review.

text: 功能更新支持展开查看详细说明和技术原理。
en: Changelog entries can expand to show details and implementation notes.

details.title: 原来的情况
details.text: 功能更新页面只显示简短摘要，难以了解问题背景、功能细节和技术实现。
details.en: The changelog showed short summaries only, leaving the background, feature details and implementation unclear.

details.title: 处理方式
details.text: 为有详细内容的更新增加可展开区域，按更新类型组织说明，并为后续记录制定中英文维护规则。
details.en: Entries with details now have an expandable section organized by change type, with a documented bilingual maintenance rule for future updates.

details.title: 更新后的效果
details.text: 读者可以按需展开今天的更新，查看功能、问题处理过程和技术原理；历史摘要保持原样。
details.en: Readers can expand today's entries to see feature descriptions, fixes and implementation notes; older summaries remain unchanged.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: 更新数据以可选的 details 数组保存双语说明，Astro 生成原生 details 和 summary 元素；展开不依赖 JavaScript，已有无详情记录仍按原样显示。
details.en: An optional details array stores bilingual sections. Astro renders native details and summary elements without requiring JavaScript; entries without details remain unchanged.

text: 修复未来规划复制后未展开发表输入框的问题。
en: Fixed the planning comment box remaining closed after copying.

details.title: 原来的情况
details.text: 复制规划后，页面始终显示只读的 Markdown 预览，而真正的 giscus 发表区域仍处于折叠状态，容易误以为预览框可以提交。
details.en: After copying a plan, a read-only Markdown preview appeared while the actual giscus comment area remained collapsed, making the preview look like an input box.

details.title: 处理方式
details.text: 复制成功时自动展开并定位到发表区域；只有自动复制失败时，才显示用于手动复制的文本。
details.en: Successful copying now opens and scrolls to the posting area. The manual-copy text appears only when clipboard access fails.

details.title: 更新后的效果
details.text: 复制后可直接在展开的 GitHub 评论框中粘贴并发表；复制失败时仍可手动复制。
details.en: After copying, paste into the expanded GitHub comment box and post. If copying fails, the text remains available for manual copying.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: 页面使用浏览器 Clipboard API 复制 Markdown，再打开 details 发表区域；giscus 是独立的跨域组件，内容仍需由用户粘贴和提交。
details.en: The page uses the Clipboard API to copy Markdown and opens the details element. Giscus runs in a cross-origin frame, so the user still pastes and submits the comment.

text: 新增未来规划专区，通过表格记录并查看文章、博客功能等规划。
en: Added a planning table for articles, blog features, and custom categories.

details.title: 功能内容
details.text: 未来规划以表格记录类型、名称、内容、计划时间和完成状态，支持搜索、按类型筛选和状态排序。填写表单后复制 Markdown 到 giscus 发表；自定义类型随已发布规划进入选项列表。
details.en: Plans display type, name, details, target date and status in a searchable table, with type filters and status sorting. A form generates Markdown for posting through giscus; published custom types become filter options.

details.title: 更新方式
details.text: 点击某行的“变更状态”，前往对应 GitHub 评论编辑。同步和部署完成后，表格显示最新状态。
details.en: Use Change status to edit the corresponding GitHub comment. The table updates after synchronization and deployment.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: 独立 Discussion 保存评论；GitHub Actions 读取站长评论并生成快照，Astro 构建时解析固定 Markdown 字段，浏览器完成筛选和排序。数据更新不需要手动提交仓库。
details.en: A dedicated Discussion stores comments. GitHub Actions snapshots the owner's comments, Astro parses fixed Markdown fields at build time, and the browser filters and sorts the table. Updating a plan does not require a manual repository commit.

text: 新增生活锦囊专区，支持直接发表和搜索实用知识。
en: Added Life Tips for publishing and searching practical knowledge.

details.title: 功能内容
details.text: 生活锦囊收集软件操作和生活中的实用知识。站长登录 GitHub 后可在页面发表，读者可以搜索标题、正文和标签；编辑或删除通过对应 GitHub 评论完成。
details.en: Life Tips collects useful software instructions and everyday knowledge. The owner can post after signing in with GitHub, and readers can search titles, content and tags. Editing and deletion use the corresponding GitHub comment.

details.title: 技术原理
details.text: giscus 将内容保存到专用 GitHub Discussion；Actions 读取站长的顶级评论生成独立快照，构建并部署页面。搜索在浏览器中进行，同步或部署期间列表可能延迟更新。
details.en: Giscus stores content in a dedicated GitHub Discussion. Actions snapshots the owner's top-level comments and builds and deploys the page. Search runs in the browser; the list may lag while synchronization and deployment complete.

text: 新增功能更新页面，按时间记录新增、删除、优化和修复。
en: Added a changelog to record additions, removals, improvements, and fixes over time.

text: 动态支持搜索和分页，发表入口移至顶部。
en: Added search and pagination to moments and moved the compose link to the top.

text: 动态显示回复，支持排序，并定时同步讨论。
en: Moments show replies, support sorting, and synchronize discussions periodically.

text: 修复动态搜索数据缓存问题。
en: Fixed stale moments search data.

text: 修复讨论变化后动态未刷新的问题。
en: Fixed moments refresh after discussion changes.

text: 新增基于 GitHub Discussion 的动态页面。
en: Added a moments feed backed by GitHub Discussions.

text: 新增可记住选择的中英文界面切换。
en: Added persistent Chinese and English interface switching.

text: 修复贴图文章默认未开启评论的问题。
en: Enabled comments by default on photo posts.

text: 新增寺庙求签和签诗展示。
en: Added temple fortune draws with poems.

text: 调整求签流程，让操作更清晰。
en: Clarified the fortune draw flow.

text: 新增人生格子旅程和交互式时光回放。
en: Added life-grid journeys and interactive time replay.

text: 丰富每日语录、站内搜索和贴图文章。
en: Enriched daily quotes, site search, and photo posts.

text: 修复固定导航换行问题。
en: Fixed fixed-navigation wrapping.

text: 统一页面场景颜色并修复背景闪烁。
en: Unified page scene colors and fixed background flashes.

text: 完善文章时间信息和导航元数据。
en: Refined article timestamps and navigation metadata.

text: 新增访客信息展示。
en: Added visitor information.

text: 新增背景音乐。
en: Added background music.

text: 新增层级分类导航和筛选。
en: Added hierarchical category navigation and filters.

text: 新增街机游戏。
en: Added arcade games.

text: 新增星球 2048。
en: Added Planet 2048.

text: 新增游戏大厅和三骰游戏。
en: Added a game lobby and a three-dice game.

text: 更新博客场景、日历和每日语录。
en: Refreshed blog scenes, the calendar, and daily quotes.

text: 建立个人博客，支持 GitHub Pages 发布。
en: Created the personal blog for GitHub Pages.
